Chapter 1288: 35: Doubt And Astonishment

Chapter 1288: Chapter 35: Doubt and Astonishment

Is it just now?

Has the technique created by the Eternal Lord been deciphered by Lin Yuan?

This left the Sect Master of the Holy Sect bewildered.

Even in such a situation where ‘demonic’ disasters are rampant, he never doubted the abilities of the Eternal Lord.

These green runes from the Eternal Lord can be destroyed, but to be refined and taken over again like Lin Yuan?

This has completely exceeded the Sect Master’s understanding.

In his opinion, achieving this feat would only be possible for another Eternal Lord of the same level.

But Lin Yuan?

“Don’t overthink it, I used a clever method.”

Lin Yuan glanced at the Sect Master of the Holy Sect and casually explained.

If forced to refine the green runes, he wouldn’t have the ability.

But using the understanding of the essence of runes by the Lord of Heaven Light, what is seen and sensed is all runes, and can all be used by me. In this way, one can reorganize the runes and bypass the method of the Eternal Lord.

Lin Yuan has practiced and comprehended the inheritance created by the Lord of Heaven Light, reaching the fourth level, on par with many Eternal Lords.

“Yes.”

The Holy Sect Master composed himself and immediately responded with respect.

Although Lin Yuan admitted he used a clever method.

The Holy Sect Master doesn’t think so at all; being able to overpower the Eternal Lord’s method and refine and take over the green runes is a testament to one’s power and realm.

Clever?

Even an Eternal Lord can resort to clever methods?

“How fortunate for our Qingyun Saint Sect.”

The Sect Master couldn’t help but think.

The stronger Lin Yuan becomes, the happier he naturally is.

After all, Lin Yuan still holds old feelings for the Holy Sect.

Otherwise, he wouldn’t have stayed in the Holy Sect for so long?

With Lin Yuan’s terrifying ability to kill a great demon as easily as squashing an ant.

The rampant ‘demonic’ presence outside doesn’t differ much from within the Holy Sect.

The ferocious and violent ‘demons’, in front of Lin Yuan, are akin to ants.

…

After taking over the green runes again.

Lin Yuan naturally discovered the full uses of the green runes.

For example, through the green runes, Lin Yuan sensed the specific location coordinates of other Holy Sects and even the Supreme Saint Sect in this Fang Yuan World.

“Currently, there are a total of eight hundred and ninety-two Holy Sects inheriting, with just over twenty Supreme Saint Sects remaining.”

Lin Yuan obtained the ‘highest authority’ of the green runes, effortlessly detecting all Holy Sect information.

“Indeed, the damage is severe.”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly.

Comparing to the number of Holy Sect forces before the great changes in the Fang Yuan World.

The current Holy Sects and Supreme Saint Sects have plummeted by more than ninety percent?

In fact, among the nearly nine hundred Holy Sects and more than twenty Supreme Saint Sects remaining, whether they still possess the foundation of a Holy Sect or Supreme Saint Sect.

Is still uncertain.

For instance, Qingyun Saint Sect.

Nominally a Holy Sect.

But it lost the presence of a powerhouse at the third stage of liberation ages ago.

Before the great changes in the world, it was no longer part of the Holy Sect.

“These locations of the Holy Sects?”

Through the ‘highest authority’ of the green runes, Lin Yuan easily locked them in.

To ensure the inheritance in the ‘demonic disaster’ environment, each Holy Sect is extremely hidden.

Even Lin Yuan, unless close enough, finds it hard to discover.

But with the help of the green runes, the position of each Holy Sect and Supreme Saint Sect is detailed in Lin Yuan’s eyes.

Moreover, he can even grasp them timely, and if the other party moves now, he can detect the movement trajectory.

“I can send avatars to infiltrate these Holy Sects and Supreme Saint Sects to obtain rune inheritances.”

Lin Yuan contemplated, as this was something he had always wanted to do but had postponed due to the inability to find the locations of the Holy Sects and Supreme Saint Sects.

But now?

There is naturally no such problem.

Even though it’s just the rune inheritance of the Holy Sect, it holds certain reference value for Lin Yuan.

“This is…”

Lin Yuan, using the green runes, detected several rapidly moving auras.

“Are they Eternal Envoys?”

Lin Yuan appeared contemplative.

These moving auras differed entirely from those of the Holy Sect and Supreme Saint Sect.

They should be the soon-to-arrive Eternal Envoys.

Now that Lin Yuan has completely taken over and refined the green runes, possessing ‘highest authority’, he is almost akin to the Eternal Lord, allowing him to sense many things, including the movements of the Eternal Envoys easily.

…

“Senior, how should we face the Eternal Envoys?”

The Sect Master of the Holy Sect asked softly, informing of the impending arrival of the Eternal Envoy, just to receive Lin Yuan’s perspective.

Lin Yuan’s attitude is precisely the attitude of the Qingyun Saint Sect.

“Welcome them as usual.”

Lin Yuan said: “The Eternal Envoy will probably arrive about a year from now. Let me know when they come.”

Lin Yuan was quite curious about the current situation at the center of Heaven and Earth, and these could be understood from the mouth of the Eternal Envoy.

“The Eternal Envoy will arrive in a year?”

The Sect Master of the Holy Sect looked at Lin Yuan.

He did not know the exact time the Eternal Envoy would arrive.

Generally, after receiving the cyan rune information, the Eternal Envoy would arrive in about a hundred years.

As for Lin Yuan being precise about a year later?

“Yes.”

“Approximately around that time.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

He deduced the arrival time of the Eternal Envoy at the Qingyun Saint Sect by perceiving the location and speed through the cyan runes.

Of course, there could be discrepancies, such as encountering a formidable ‘demon,’ which might cause delays, but the overall error wouldn’t be too significant.

“Yes.”

The Sect Master of the Qingyun Saint Sect respectfully withdrew.

He had no doubt about Lin Yuan’s words.

…

The first Fang Yuan World.

In the Fierce Sun Capital, Lin Yuan sat there, facing the Ancestor of Fierce Sun.

“Ancestor’s Fierce Spirit Drunken, indeed a fine wine…” Lin Yuan sipped the wine gently, smiling as he spoke.

Fierce Spirit Drunken is a fine wine personally brewed by the Ancestor of Fierce Sun, even a thirteenth-tier temporal being would feel divine after a sip. Lin Yuan, though with a strong physique, would only dare drink a little at a time.

“Hahaha.”

The Ancestor of Fierce Sun laughed heartily, the best wine in this world is precisely his brewed Fierce Spirit Drunken.

Only Lin Yuan among other Ancestors would be served by the Ancestor of Fierce Sun.

“How’s your recent cultivation progress?” The Ancestor of Fierce Sun asked: “Planning to take that step soon?”

“There’s no rush.”

Lin Yuan shook his head: “Continue accumulating for a while.”

“Alright.”

The Ancestor of Fierce Sun nodded.

In the many future timelines concerning Lin Yuan that he saw, rarely did he immediately step forth.

“Ancestor, will this world face destruction?” Lin Yuan asked casually, looking at the vast Fang Yuan World.

“Destruction?” The Ancestor of Fierce Sun pondered for a moment, nodded, and said: “Naturally, it will face destruction. Every world will inevitably face destruction. It’s not complete destruction, but a new beginning will be nurtured.”

Hearing this, Lin Yuan nodded slightly.

In the Chaos Void, each naturally formed universe will face immense destruction, subsequently reopening.

This merely reflects the operational rules of numerous worldly realms.

The Source World is no exception; it is just far more perfect compared to the Chaos Void, with the time from birth to massive destruction far exceeding that of the Chaos Void.

“When this world faces destruction, we beings of time must leave, wandering in inter-dimensional spaces.”

The Ancestor of Fierce Sun said: “But that day is still far away.”

“Yes, it’s still far away.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

The time since the opening of the First Fang Yuan World till now is far shorter than that of the Second Fang Yuan World.

…

The Second Fang Yuan World.

Demonic Qi wafted around.

Three figures, their presence barely perceptible, tore through layers of Demonic Qi, and continuously traversed towards a certain direction.

These three figures kept their aura extremely concealed, and the spatiotemporal disturbances caused by their void travel were nearly nonexistent.

During each of their traverse, the three figures exchanged dialogues.

“Should we proceed towards the Qingyun Saint Sect next?”

“As the magic disaster descends, such a sect barely reaching the threshold would find it hard to survive.”

The two figures at the back, one male and one female, looked at the infinite Demonic Qi around them, their expressions slightly grave.

These three figures were precisely the envoys from the Eternal Sect at the center of Heaven and Earth.

At that moment.

The foremost figure abruptly halted its traverse, vigilantly observing the surroundings.

“Something’s wrong.”

The foremost figure was a middle-aged man with silver eyes, continuously observing the surroundings, his expression filled with suspicion.

“What’s going on?”

The male and female following behind stopped as well.

After observing for a while, they used telepathy to inquire.

“Haven’t you noticed that there isn’t a single respectable ‘demon’ in this area?”

The longer the silver-eyed middle-aged man observed, the more suspicious his expression grew.
